scope: Proposition 2.1 of the manuscript “The Stable Hurewicz Image of the Sphere at Two” (preprints/The-Stable-Hurewicz-Image-of-the-Sphere-at-Two-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 316 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4234ea3418d229fb), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 5. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: There is a natural equivalence of augmented commutative ring spectra Σ∞ + C(X) ≃ P(Σ∞ X). The reduced suspension spectrum of C(X), based at its unit, corresponds to the sum of the positive weights. The adjoint of projection to weight one is the canonical map C(X) −→ QX. This map is group completion and is an equivalence when X is connected. In the connected case, the weight-one projection is consequently the stable counit Σ∞QX → Σ∞X.
